attacker_capability: Present an IP package under a misleading provider identity or approval status.
attacker_precondition: Ability to publish, mirror, or substitute a third-party IP package
consequence: Untrusted logic enters synthesis as a trusted hardware component
evidence_requirement: Provider identity; package digest; signed release; IP intake review
detection_evidence: Provider identity check; package digest mismatch; dependency manifest review
external_mapping: SSDF supplier review; HBOM/SBOM component identity

attacker_capability: Modify HDL, packaged IP, or IP metadata before synthesis.
attacker_precondition: Write access to HDL/IP source, package cache, or workspace
consequence: Reviewed design intent diverges from synthesized hardware behavior
evidence_requirement: Source digest; review record; dependency/IP metadata manifest
detection_evidence: Source digest; code review record; synthesis input manifest

attacker_capability: Read or export proprietary HDL/IP from repositories, build storage, or release bundles.
attacker_precondition: Read access to repository, build artifacts, or release storage
consequence: Proprietary hardware structure or IP composition is exposed
evidence_requirement: Access log; repository policy; export record
detection_evidence: Repository access log; artifact download log; export record
external_mapping: SSDF data protection; HBOM/SBOM access governance

attacker_capability: Modify testbenches, golden vectors, simulation models, scripts, logs, or simulation reports.
attacker_precondition: Write access to testbenches, golden vectors, simulation models, expected-output files, or simulation logs
consequence: Verification evidence no longer corresponds to the reviewed design or cannot justify downstream signoff decisions
evidence_requirement: Testbench digest; simulation log; expected-result manifest
detection_evidence: Verification collateral digest; simulation command/log; expected-result manifest; review record

attacker_capability: Read, alter, omit, or relabel simulation-result files, waveform records, simulator logs, or coverage/result evidence.
attacker_precondition: Read or write access to simulation results, waveform files, result logs, coverage records, or simulator-written evidence
consequence: Simulation-result evidence can be leaked, altered, omitted, or disconnected from reviewed verification evidence
evidence_requirement: Result manifest; waveform/log digest; simulation command; access log
detection_evidence: Result manifest; waveform/log digest; simulation command; access log

artifact: Timing, pin, placement, or exception constraints
attacker_capability: Alter XDC/SDC/PDC/FDC/NDC constraints, timing exceptions, pin constraints, or waivers without review evidence.
attacker_precondition: Write access to timing, pin, placement, or device constraints
consequence: Hardware implementation and signoff assumptions change without HDL changes
evidence_requirement: Constraint digest; change rationale; approval record; exception/waiver record
detection_evidence: Constraint digest; target-device record; approval record

attacker_capability: Alter scripts, tool options, seeds, hierarchy controls, security options, or implementation settings.
attacker_precondition: Ability to modify tool options, scripts, seeds, or project settings
consequence: Transformation behavior changes while sources appear unchanged
evidence_requirement: Command manifest; option snapshot; tool version; security-option record
detection_evidence: Command manifest; option snapshot; tool version record

attacker_capability: Introduce constraints/settings that cause repeated timing, routing, or resource failures.
attacker_precondition: Ability to alter constraints or options that affect timing/resource closure
consequence: Build or release is delayed through repeated timing/resource failure
evidence_requirement: Constraint history; build-resource log; failure record
detection_evidence: Failure logs; constraint history; resource-utilization reports

artifact: Tool binary, plugin, Tcl package, or build container
boundary: Toolchain environment to artifact transformation run
attacker_capability: Substitute or alter the EDA executable, plugin, Tcl package, IP generator, or build container used to produce artifacts.
attacker_precondition: Ability to substitute or alter an EDA executable, plugin, Tcl package, IP generator, runner image, or build container
consequence: Generated netlists, reports, or bitstreams may derive from an unapproved tool environment while inputs appear unchanged
evidence_requirement: Tool/image digest; installation manifest; plugin/package digest; runner provenance; tool-version attestation
detection_evidence: Tool/image digest; installation manifest; plugin/package digest; runner provenance; tool-version attestation
external_mapping: SLSA builder provenance; in-toto layout; SSDF toolchain integrity

boundary: License source/state to tool or IP availability
attacker_capability: Change, hide, omit, or fail to record license-source or license-state evidence for a tool or IP-dependent build step.
attacker_precondition: Ability to change, hide, omit, or fail to record license-source or license-state evidence for a tool or IP-dependent build step
consequence: Tool or IP-generation availability and build authorization cannot be explained after the run
evidence_requirement: License file/server record; license report; feature log; build log
detection_evidence: License file/server record; license report; feature log; build log
external_mapping: SSDF configuration management; SCRM dependency provenance

boundary: Tool/IP version state to generated artifact lineage
attacker_capability: Change, downgrade, upgrade, or omit the tool/IP version state used to generate FPGA artifacts.
attacker_precondition: Ability to change, downgrade, upgrade, or omit tool/IP version or update-state evidence used to generate FPGA artifacts
consequence: Artifacts may be generated with unexpected tool, IP-generator, or database-version state while source and constraints appear unchanged
evidence_requirement: Tool version; IP status or upgrade log; installation manifest; database-version record
detection_evidence: Tool version; IP status or upgrade log; installation manifest; database-version record
external_mapping: SLSA provenance; in-toto step attestation; SSDF configuration management

attacker_capability: Modify or substitute generated netlists, synthesized design checkpoints, or equivalent intermediate outputs.
attacker_precondition: Ability to replace or edit generated netlists or checkpoints
consequence: Intermediate representation no longer derives from approved source and constraints
evidence_requirement: Input-output digest chain; synthesis log
detection_evidence: Input-output digest chain; synthesis log; checkpoint digest

attacker_capability: Reuse stale implementation state or alter checkpoints, seeds, route databases, or option history.
attacker_precondition: Ability to reuse stale implementation state or alter implementation database/seed
consequence: Placed-and-routed state may not correspond to approved inputs
evidence_requirement: Seed/options manifest; checkpoint digest; route lineage
detection_evidence: Checkpoint digest; seed/options manifest; route lineage

attacker_capability: Drive implementation into resource exhaustion, routing failure, or pathological runtime through constraints/settings.
attacker_precondition: Ability to influence routing constraints, seeds, or resource pressure
consequence: Implementation cannot complete or repeatedly misses closure
evidence_requirement: Build-resource log; options history; route failure record
detection_evidence: Route failure record; resource log; options history

boundary: Tool output to human signoff/release decision
attacker_capability: Modify, suppress, regenerate, or replace timing, utilization, DRC, power, exception, or signoff reports.
attacker_precondition: Ability to edit, suppress, regenerate, or replace generated signoff reports
consequence: Release decision relies on false timing, DRC, CDC, or utilization evidence
evidence_requirement: Report digest; generator command; timestamp; exception/waiver record
detection_evidence: Report digest; generator command; timestamp; report-to-artifact link

attacker_capability: Trigger or publish builds without durable linkage among source, constraints, options, tool identity, reports, and approval.
attacker_precondition: Missing or deletable build, approval, or artifact lineage records
consequence: Released bitstream cannot be traced to source, constraints, options, reports, and approval
evidence_requirement: Source-to-bitstream digest chain; CI identity; tool/image identity; attestation
detection_evidence: Source-to-bitstream digest chain; CI identity; attestation

attacker_capability: Read reports/logs from build storage, report archives, or release bundles beyond intended recipients.
attacker_precondition: Read access to detailed reports or logs outside intended release scope
consequence: Timing paths, resource structure, IP composition, or constraints reveal design details
evidence_requirement: Report permissions; access logs; release classification
detection_evidence: Report access logs; release classification; download records

attacker_capability: Replace, relabel, replay, downgrade, or substitute a bitstream/programming file before release or programming.
attacker_precondition: Ability to substitute or relabel bitstream/programming artifact before release or programming
consequence: Device can be configured with a hardware image not tied to approved design evidence
evidence_requirement: Bitstream digest; signature where configured; release manifest; programming log; rollback record
detection_evidence: Bitstream digest; signature verification; release manifest; programming log
external_mapping: FPGA security guidance; SLSA release provenance

attacker_capability: Read bitstreams, signing material, encryption material, debug metadata, or release bundles.
attacker_precondition: Read access to bitstreams, signing material, encryption material, or release bundle
consequence: Configuration image or key material leaks from storage or release process
evidence_requirement: Key-handling record; access log; encryption status; debug metadata classification
detection_evidence: Key access log; artifact download log; encryption status
external_mapping: FPGA security guidance; SSDF secrets management

attacker_capability: Use signing, approval, promotion, or release authority outside the intended FPGA artifact workflow.
attacker_precondition: Access to signing service, release role, approval token, or release credential
consequence: A bitstream can be signed, promoted, or released without the intended release authority
evidence_requirement: Signer identity; approval record; release manifest
detection_evidence: Signer identity; approval record; release manifest; protected-environment log
mitigation_family: Separation of build, signing, release, and programming duties
external_mapping: SLSA provenance; in-toto; SSDF access control

attacker_capability: Program an unauthorized target, spoof target identity, or alter/delete programming records.
attacker_precondition: Ability to program a target, spoof target identity, or alter/delete programming records
consequence: A released artifact can be programmed to the wrong or unauthorized FPGA target
evidence_requirement: Target identity; programmer identity; programming log; rollback record
detection_evidence: Target identity; programmer identity; programming log; rollback record
external_mapping: FPGA configuration guidance; SSDF access control; deployment audit logging

boundary: Programming/debug evidence to deployment audit boundary
attacker_capability: Alter, delete, omit, or disclose programming-status, readback/verify, or debug-capture evidence.
attacker_precondition: Access to programming status, readback/verify data, debug-capture evidence, or deployment audit logs
consequence: Deployment accountability weakens or debug/readback evidence leaks implementation-sensitive state
evidence_requirement: Readback/status log; verify command; debug capture digest; access log
detection_evidence: Readback/status log; verify command; debug-capture digest; access log
external_mapping: FPGA configuration guidance; SSDF logging and data protection

attacker_capability: Release artifacts without complete manifests, workflow identity, digest sets, or approval records.
attacker_precondition: Release process lacks durable manifest, attestation, workflow identity, or artifact retention
consequence: Released FPGA artifacts cannot be audited back to source, constraints, tool identity, reports, bitstream, and approval
evidence_requirement: Workflow identity; artifact digest set; tool identity; attestation
detection_evidence: Workflow identity; artifact digest set; tool identity; release attestation

attacker_capability: Abuse release-automation service accounts, runners, tokens, protected environments, or release jobs affecting FPGA artifacts.
attacker_precondition: Release-automation actor or service account has excessive build, sign, release, overwrite, or routing authority
consequence: Automated pipeline can publish, sign, overwrite, or route FPGA configuration artifacts toward deployment outside the intended workflow
evidence_requirement: Release approval; signing event; service account identity; protected-environment record
detection_evidence: Release approval; signing event; service-account identity; protected-environment record
external_mapping: SSDF access control; SLSA builder identity; in-toto layout
